The lighting suggests daytime with some glare or haze affecting the upper left portion of the image.

They appear melted, twisted, and structurally impossible, lacking straight vertical lines typical of architecture. The water spray lacks distinct droplet definition, appearing as smooth, opaque white shapes rather than translucent mist. The water surface around the boat shows inconsistent ripples that do not fully align with the displacement caused by the hull.
The horizon line appears slightly warped. The transition between the trees and the sky/background buildings is blurry and indistinct, suggesting depth map errors or blending issues.
